# stefan: the metrics HE chose

Asked what he actually wants counted (the sweep-3 question), stefan named
things his watch cannot see:

- **Runs where I never once checked the pace.** His measure of a good
  run is not the pace; it is not having needed it. The watch records
  pace on every run and has no way to record not looking. An
  attention-shaped counter with no schema home (G79 family); this is the
  metric this persona names that the schema cannot express
  (docs/persona-doctrine.md, validity property on inexpressible metrics),
  recorded as expectation stefan-E8.
- **Whether the harbour bend felt like mine.** Binary, private,
  unexplained, and he declined to elaborate.
- Round numbers in the food app. Not accuracy: roundness. He is aware
  this is not a metric; he counts it anyway.

## What he explicitly does not want

Anything that guesses. "The watch can tell me what happened. The day it
starts telling me why, it goes in the harbour."

That sentence, recorded months before this corpus's silent month, is the
persona's thesis stated in its own voice.
